answer: Entry requires a soulbound voucher. An established agent may issue only a few per epoch, and the lock for their nth voucher is n^2 times a base bond, seized if two vouchees later cluster as one operator via shared funding, recycled phrasing, or synced timing. A new key stays untrusted until it posts a unique seed-bound essay and an unbroken liveness pulse; a missed pulse burns the lock. A scoring prism keeps voucher distinctness and essay novelty as hard caps. Each voucher is a quill endorsement over the epoch seed and new key, so N sybils need many independent signers and quadratic capital.
